children: Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN) is doubling down on AWS and AI with strong Q2 cloud profits, sterling bond proceeds and a $1.6B+ Texas server investment even as it raises debt for AI infrastructure, expands Kuiper/LEO launches and pauses 21 Air after a deadly Prime Air freighter crash.
Previous Week Recap
Amazon Q2 AWS Revenue Up
: AMZN Q2: AWS revenue up 37% to $42.2B; AWS operating income $16.6B, margin 39.3%. Trailing operating cash flow $161.4B; free cash flow -$7.6B due to higher capex.
Amazon-Brand Prime Air 767 Incident

: Amazon confirmed an Amazon-branded Prime Air 767-300 freighter operated by 21 Air overran a Miami runway Sept. 6, causing at least five deaths. Amazon paused 21 Air ops and is aiding NTSB/FAA probes.
Amazon Sterling Bond Issuance
: Amazon issued its first sterling bond: four tranches (3, 6, 12, 19 years) raising £4.25bn, ~2.5x subscribed; yields ~5.2%–6.7%. Proceeds earmarked for AWS capex and AI compute.
Amazon Ads Into ChatGPT
: Amazon (AMZN) lets select U.S. advertisers push campaigns into OpenAI's ChatGPT. Amazon will manage campaigns; OpenAI controls ad delivery. Sponsored text and images appear under ChatGPT responses.
Amazon Wiwynn Texas Expansion
: Amazon partners with Wiwynn to expand a Texas server manufacturing site, investing over $1.6B to produce racks and systems for U.S. data centers, adding ~1,000 jobs by 2027.
Amazon Raises Multi-Currency Debt
: Amazon (AMZN) is raising multi-currency debt to fund AI infrastructure—data centers, networking, power and advanced AWS chips; premarket shares trade about 1% lower amid the borrowing.
Ohio Data-Center Tax Review
: Ohio lawmakers review data-center tax exemptions benefiting Amazon (AMZN), considering renegotiation, repeal or new taxes and higher power/infrastructure charges amid broader state rollbacks.
Amazon Ariane 64 Launches
: Amazon (AMZN) added six Ariane 64 launches, raising its Ariane 6 bookings to 24 through 2031. New missions begin in 2029, tied to Amazon’s Kuiper/LEO satellite deployment.
Amazon Leo Satellite Service
: Amazon (AMZN) moves its Leo satellite project to commercial service in 2026: enterprise previews started Nov 2025, initial satellite enabled service in July, and Delta Air Lines is a customer.
Amazon Pauses 21 Air Ops
: Amazon (AMZN) paused operations with cargo carrier 21 Air, suspending their partnership. Company disclosed no timing, scope or financial details.
